description: Standard Chartered expects the $6.3 billion Binance hack to encourage greater adoption of decentralised exchanges as investors reassess the risks of centralised platforms. The bank's global head of digital assets research, Geoffrey Kendrick, identified Uniswap as a potential beneficiary and maintained a $100 price target for its token by 2030. CoinGecko data showed decentralised exchanges increased their combined trading volume share to 23.5 percent in Q2 2026, despite declining activity across both centralised and decentralised platforms.
title: Uniswap Could Benefit From Binance Hack as Standard Chartered Eyes DEX Growth

description: Binance has resumed USDT, USDC, and ETH withdrawals on Ethereum, alongside BNB withdrawals on BNB Smart Chain, following the October 29 attack that reportedly resulted in $6.3 billion in stolen cryptocurrency. Bitcoin withdrawals were restored earlier as part of a phased reopening. While deposits remain operational, other withdrawal networks are still undergoing security checks. Binance also said it had replaced around 95 percent of the affected assets, while US President Donald Trump confirmed that his administration was investigating the incident.
title: Binance Resumes USDT, USDC, ETH and BNB Withdrawals as Trump Addresses Situation

description: Google's new shopping experience uses its Shopping Graph, which includes more than 60 billion products, to recommend fashion and lifestyle items. The Discover Shop feed also incorporates YouTube videos and Google's visual search technology. Users can preview select clothing through virtual try-on, while image uploads and camera searches help them find similar products online. The company plans to introduce pre-generated daily outfit suggestions later. Access currently depends on a limited pilot in India and requires users to enable specific Google account activity settings.
title: Google Pay Introduces Discover Shop With AI Virtual Try-On, Visual Search in India

description: The Sony FX5 brings several professional video recording features to the company's Cinema Line, including 16-bit X-OCN RAW recording and Open Gate support. Its full-frame sensor offers three base ISO settings, while the autofocus system uses AI to recognise and track different subjects. The camera also supports five-axis in-body image stabilisation, four-channel audio recording and network streaming. Sony has priced the FX5 from Rs. 5,09,990 in India, with an optional XLR handle unit and detachable OLED viewfinder.
title: Sony FX5 Cinema Line Camera Launched in India With Open Gate Recording, 5K Video Support: Price, Specifications

description: Nvidia has rolled out new four-month GeForce Now plans across Performance and Ultimate tiers. The four-month plans cost Rs. 3,499 and Rs. 6,999, respectively. The new plans are approximately 12 percent cheaper than the monthly plans extended over four months. Additionally, Nvidia has also added nine new games to Ge Force Now.
title: Nvidia GeForce Now Introduces 4-Month Plans in India at Lower Prices

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out Smart Text Actions on Android and iOS. The new feature allows users to save contacts, create calendar events, open addresses and more directly from chats. Long-pressing a message with an email address, phone number, address, or meeting time will prompt the app to suggest actions like sending emails, saving contacts, or creating calendar events.
title: WhatsApp Introduces Smart Text Actions on Android and iOS: Report

description: OpenAI may be exploring deeper health data integration for ChatGPT on Android through Google's Health Connect platform. References found in the app's code point to permissions covering physical measurements, reproductive health information and background access to health records. The findings also suggest that ChatGPT could introduce additional interfaces to explain its data access requirements. The potential integration would bring Android users closer to the health data sharing experience that iPhone users already have through Apple Health, although OpenAI has not confirmed the feature.
title: ChatGPT Health Could Soon Get Google Health Integration on Android: Report

description: Privacy Display feature debuted with the Galaxy S26 Ultra. This feature is designed to safeguard users' confidential details by hiding their full screen from others. A new report states that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will feature an upgraded Privacy Display feature. If the information proves accurate, the Galaxy S27 Pro would become the first non-Ultra Galaxy S flagship to feature Samsung's Privacy Display technology.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro, Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Feature Upgraded Privacy Display Technology

description: Apple is planning to bring multiple upgrades to the HomeView with the HomeView software 27.2 update. In a post on X, user pdfu (@itspdfu) has shared that Apple’s HomeView will soon be able to act as a home security camera as part of the HomeKit environment. The user spotted the functionality in the HomeView Software 27.2 update. The update reportedly offers a better view of the “functionality and privacy protections.” The HomeView is said to work as a security camera with HomeKit Secure Video, and will be capable of activity detection, streaming, and recording.
title: HomeView to Double as Apple’s HomeKit Security Camera, Receive Dedicated Claude and ChatGPT Apps Soon, Tipster Claims

description: The festive season is in full swing right now. But if you’re looking to upgrade your smartphone, then the market has seen phone prices rapidly climb due to an ongoing shortage of essential memory components. This crunch has made already premium smartphones, particularly high-end flagships from brands like Samsung and Apple, even more expensive to purchase under normal circumstances. Thankfully, the Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition sale has arrived just in time. It offers a small window for buyers to grab these devices at significantly lower prices than their standard market rates ahead of Diwali.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale: Best Deals on Samsung Smartphones, iPhones

description: Pebble Qore Vox has been launched in India as the latest screenless fitness tracker from the company. It is currently on sale in the country via the Pebble online store, Amazon, and Flipkart. The Pebble Qore Vox is offered in three colour options, namely Stealth Black, Storm Blue, and Summit Brown. The Pebble Qore Vox is a screenless fitness tracker that also ships with multiple AI-powered features. The wearable allows users to double-tap the physical button on the side to start recording conversations, meetings, lectures, or personal reminders. The fitness tracker can provide summaries and transcriptions of these recordings, which can be accessed via the Pebble Vox app.
title: Pebble Qore Vox Launched in India as Firm’s Latest Screenless Fitness Tracker With AI Voice Recording Capabilities: Price, Features

description: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ makes a convincing case for a premium tablet that can handle more than streaming and browsing. Its display is great for entertainment, performance is strong, and Samsung DeX makes multitasking useful. The optional keyboard adds to its productivity appeal but also raises the overall cost. It is a capable all-rounder, but its price demands serious consideration.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ Review: A Premium Tablet With Laptop Ambitions

description: Bitcoin traded near $78,200 on Monday after falling to $76,400 on Friday following the reported $6.3 billion Binance hack. The incident triggered nearly $1.57 billion in futures liquidations, while US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $643.2 million in outflows, erasing inflows from the preceding four sessions. Investors are also monitoring the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate outlook and upcoming US employment data.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $78,200 as Binance Hack and ETF Outflows Weigh on Crypto Markets

description: Vivo is reportedly working on Vivo X500 Ultra and Vivo X500s. The Ultra model could feature a triple rear camera setup comprising two 50-megapixel sensors and a 200-megapixel sensor. The flagship is also tipped to feature a 50-megapixel front camera. The company is said to be testing a 68-megapixel selfie camera for its next-generation S-series smartphone. The purported sensor could feature a square design and may eventually debut on the Vivo X500s.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Camera Specifications Leaked; 68-Megapixel Selfie Camera Tipped for Vivo X500s

description: The Vivo Y32 5G could arrive as a new addition to the company's Y32 series, with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset replacing the Unisoc processor used in the 4G model. A report details several other expected specifications, including a 6.87-inch 120Hz LCD screen, a 50-megapixel rear camera and an 8-megapixel selfie shooter. The handset is also said to pack an 8,000mAh battery, support 44W charging and offer IP68 and IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: Vivo Y32 5G With Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC, 8,000mAh Battery, IP69 Rating Reportedly Listed

description: The Redmi Pad 3 appears to be inching closer to its launch as the successor to the Redmi Pad 2, which first debuted in June 2025. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to confirm the tablet, it has now been spotted on a certification site. The listing identifies the purported tablet by the model number and also confirms its moniker. The Redmi Pad 3 had previously also surfaced on various certification sites, suggesting that its launch could be on the horizon.
title: Redmi Pad 3 Receives SIRIM Certification in Malaysia Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Apple recently introduced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro with a ProLED XDR display at its 'Pro and Tell' event. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is expected to introduce second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pro models next year. These laptops could feature M7 Pro and M7 Max processors. The company is also reportedly developing an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M7 chip.
title: Apple May Discontinue Non-Touch MacBook Pro Models Next Year: Mark Gurman

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max are set to launch in global markets this month, the company has announced. The two handsets debuted in China in September, powered by Qualcomm’s latest flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chipsets. While most of the specifications officially remain under wraps, Xiaomi has confirmed the same SoCs for the global models. The company had previously teased the India launch of the Xiaomi 18 Pro, following which it was showcased at the Indian Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro, Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Global Launch Timeline Announced

description: Oppo's upcoming tablet lineup could include 4G, 5G and Wi-Fi-only models, according to new certification listings in China. Four devices bearing different model numbers have reportedly received 3C approval, with charging speeds ranging between 33W and 45W. The OPD2614 is listed with 5G connectivity and could be the cellular version of the Pad Air 6. Oppo has also teased a redesigned Notes app for the tablet, with features aimed at simplifying image sharing and video editing.
title: Oppo Pad Air 6 Bags 3C Certification, Charging Details Surface Ahead of November Launch

description: Redmi M100 Pro has been launched in the Chinese market. It has a 6.67-inch curved 1.5K OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection. Under the hood, it runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 7300-Ultra chipset. It has a 5,500mAh battery that supports 45W wired charging. The new phone is launched in four colours.
title: Redmi M100 Pro Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 7300-Ultra SoC, Triple Rear Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus Turbo 6Vs has been launched in China as the fifth addition to the OnePlus Turbo 6 lineup. The handset is currently available for purchase in China via the Oppo online store. It is offered in two colour options, namely Nova White and Orange Heart (translated from Chinese). The OnePlus Turbo 6Vs is a dual-SIM smartphone. It ships with Oppo’s Android 16-based ColorOS 16. The phone sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) AMOLED display, with up to a 144Hz refresh rate, a 300Hz touch sampling rate, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, 1.07 billion colours, 450 ppi pixel density, and up to 1,800 nits peak brightness. The tech firm claims that the handset ships with IP66 + IP68 + IP69 + IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: OnePlus Turbo 6Vs Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Both the Vivo T6 Lite and iQOO Z12 Lite have appeared on Bluetooth SIG’s website confirming their model names. While the Vivo T6 Lite had appeared on India’s BIS website earlier, the iQOO Z12 Lite’s specifications were revealed in a recent leak.
title: Vivo T6 Lite 5G, iQOO Z12 Lite 5G Spotted on Bluetooth SIG, Could Be Rebranded Versions of Each Other

description: Phantom Blade Zero has sold over 4 million copies on PC and PS5. Developer S-Game confirmed the sales milestone in a social media post on Monday. The action-adventure title also crossed over 800,000 concurrent players on Steam over the weekend. Phantom Blade Zero is among the most played games on Steam right now.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Sells 4 Million Copies, Reaches Over 800,000 Concurrent Players on Steam

description: Karbonn Rebel Pro and Rebel have been launched in India, marking the company's return. The smartphone maker is offering a Rs. 1,000 bank discount, bringing the effective prices to Rs. 10,999 and Rs. 11,499, respectively. Both smartphones are set to go on sale in India on November 4 at 12 pm IST via Amazon. The Karbonn Rebel is offered in Blue, Gold, and Silver colour options. On the other hand, the Karbonn Rebel Pro will be available for purchase in Blue, Cherry Red, Gold, and Gray colourways. The handsets ship with Android 16, which is claimed to offer a bloatware-free user experience. Further, the tech firm promises two years of OS upgrades and two years of security updates for the Rebel series phones.
title: Karbonn Rebel Pro and Rebel Launched in India With Up to 7,000mAh Battery, Marking Firm’s Comeback: Price, Specifications

description: Xiaomi is preparing four devices that are currently identified by their internal codenames. These include 'rome', 'fengtian', 'feynman', and 'jilin'. It is said to be gearing up to add XRING-related features to a Snapdragon-powered smartphone. A new AI video segmentation and a new camera gesture emoji option are also said to be in the works.
title: Xiaomi Said to Be Working on Four New Devices, Could Launch Offline XiaoAI

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 will be equipped with an under-display camera on the foldable screen, according to a tipster. Apart from this, the South Korean tech giant is also planning to bring “major” changes to the internals of the book-style foldable. However, the overall thickness and design could see little changes from this year’s passport-style Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Earlier, the tipster had shared that the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 will be closer to Apple’s iPhone Duo in terms of dimensions. It is worth noting that Apple launched the iPhone Duo in September with an under-display camera, which the tech giant calls a FaceTime camera. While the company has yet to confirm these details, it looks like Samsung is trying to compete directly with the iPhone Duo next year by bringing the two foldables even closer.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 to Mark the Return of Under-Display Camera, Tipster Claims

description: The OnePlus Buds Pro 4 will feature an 11mm woofer, a 6mm planar tweeter and independent dual DACs, with audio tuning by Dynaudio. Their specifications also include adaptive ANC, Spatial Audio with head tracking, AI Live Translation and Clear Audio Recording. The earbuds support Bluetooth 6.1, dual-device connectivity and wireless charging. OnePlus claims up to 53 hours of battery life with the charging case, while the earbuds carry an IP55 rating. Pricing and launch details are yet to be announced.
title: OnePlus Buds Pro 4 Specifications, Features Officially Revealed Ahead of Launch

description: Motorola announced its Signature 27 flagship smartphone at a recent event but did not reveal too many details. A new hands-on video now reveals some of the missing hardware details along with some additional hardware that wasn’t revealed during the unveiling.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Hands-On Video Reveals Tandem OLED Display, Dedicated Motion Sensors and More

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition is now live, following up on the massive success of the primary festive sale. With the festive celebrations approaching, this special edition gives buyers another golden opportunity to snap up the smartphones on their wish lists at significantly lower prices than standard market rates. Whether you are looking for top-tier flagships or reliable mid-range daily drivers, e-commerce discounts combined with festive incentives make this the ideal window to upgrade to a new smartphone.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition: Lucrative Deals on iPhone 16, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and More

description: AI is changing the way people are writing their prose, according to a report. The report highlights the case of writer Mia Ballard, whose life took a turn for the worse after the Hachette Book Group dropped plans to publish her book. The decision was reportedly made after the AI detection software, Pangram, gave her book, ‘Shy Girl’, a 78.3 percent AI-written score. Ballard refuses the claims. She reportedly claims that the person who edited her book used AI for refinement without her knowledge. Later, Ballard self-published a novella, ‘Poly’, which she wrote from a mental health facility after the AI-written controversy surrounding ‘Shy Girl’, drawing racist comments online.
title: AI Detection Tools Are Influencing Writing Styles as Writers Fear Being Falsely Accused of Plagiarism: Report

description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) launched WhatsApp-based services on Sunday. As part of the move, subscribers will now be able to check their Provident Fund (PF) balance, access passbook details, and view their latest five transactions through the messaging platform. It is also said to provide personalised guidance to members completing requirements under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY). The facility was announced by the Union Labour and Employment Minister Mansukh Mandaviya during the organisation's 74th Foundation Day celebrations.
title: EPFO Launches WhatsApp Services to Check PF Balance, Passbook, and Recent Transactions

description: Apple is said to be preparing to launch three new iPad models early next year. The Cupertino-based tech giant recently introduced the iPad mini (2026) as its first non-Pro offering to feature an OLED screen, alongside other upgrades. According to a seasoned journalist, other models in Apple's portfolio, such as the iPad Air, could get an upgrade to an OLED display. Meanwhile, the entry-level iPad is expected to be powered by a newer processor.
title: Apple to Reportedly Launch New iPad Air With OLED Screen, iPad Pro and Entry-Level iPad in H1 2027
